name: notif-bell-toggle
description: Bell dropdown push toggle: absent until first opt-in, present as TURN OFF once opted in, and STAYS present as TURN ON after opting out. Drives state through the dev-only window.__notifStatus seam because @devvit/notifications cannot initialise under the vite dev server (optIn returns 500 'Devvit config is not available'), so supported:false makes the real states unreachable locally. Never clicks .bnav-play - on the already-active PLAY tab that launches a casual match and leaves the lobby, the only page the bell exists on.

steps.expression: typeof window.__notifStatus === 'object' ? 'seam present' : 'SEAM MISSING - dev bridge did not load'
steps.name: 0 - dev seam available

steps.expression: (() => { window.__notifStatus.set({ loaded:true, supported:true, everOptedIn:false, optedIn:false }); return JSON.stringify(window.__notifStatus.get()); })()
steps.name: A - state: never opted in

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('[data-testid=notif-opt-toggle]'); return JSON.stringify({ togglePresent: !!btn, PASS: !btn, expected: 'absent' }); })()
steps.name: B - toggle HIDDEN before first opt-in

steps.expression: (() => { window.__notifStatus.set({ loaded:true, supported:true, everOptedIn:true, optedIn:true }); return JSON.stringify(window.__notifStatus.get()); })()
steps.name: C - state: opted in

steps._comment: CORE ASSERTION: toggle appears once the user has opted in

steps.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('[data-testid=notif-opt-row]'); const btn = document.querySelector('[data-testid=notif-opt-toggle]'); const label = btn?.textContent.trim() ?? null; return JSON.stringify({ toggleLabel: label, ariaPressed: btn?.getAttribute('aria-pressed') ?? null, footLabel: row?.querySelector('.lb2-notif-foot-label')?.textContent.trim() ?? null, PASS: !!label && label.includes('TURN OFF') }); })()
steps.name: D - toggle shows TURN OFF while ON

steps.expression: (() => { window.__notifStatus.set({ loaded:true, supported:true, everOptedIn:true, optedIn:false }); return JSON.stringify(window.__notifStatus.get()); })()
steps.name: E - state: opted out (everOptedIn sticky)

steps.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('[data-testid=notif-opt-row]'); const btn = document.querySelector('[data-testid=notif-opt-toggle]'); const label = btn?.textContent.trim() ?? null; return JSON.stringify({ toggleStillPresent: !!btn, toggleLabel: label, footLabel: row?.querySelector('.lb2-notif-foot-label')?.textContent.trim() ?? null, PASS: !!label && label.includes('TURN ON'), expected: 'stays visible as TURN ON - opt-out must NOT hide it' }); })()
steps.name: F - toggle SURVIVES opt-out as TURN ON

steps.expression: (() => { window.__notifStatus.set({ loaded:true, supported:false, everOptedIn:true, optedIn:false }); return 'set unsupported'; })()
steps.name: G - state: plugin unsupported

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('[data-testid=notif-opt-toggle]'); return JSON.stringify({ togglePresent: !!btn, PASS: !btn, expected: 'absent - no controls when plugin unavailable' }); })()
steps.name: H - toggle hidden when plugin unsupported
